title: haplopappus acradenius var. bracteosus
intro: Haplopappus acradenius var. bracteosus, commonly known as  the Desert Chicory or Desert Haplopappus, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Haplopappus acradenius var. bracteosus include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial actions, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
